assets.brief: Wide 3:1 promotional banner, home cinema loudspeaker ensemble with walnut floorstanding speakers, black center speaker, compact surrounds and matte black subwoofer. Exact title 'RECOMMENDED HOME THEATER' in restrained white typography near top. No other text.

Wide 3:1 promotional banner, a curated line-up of walnut and black floorstanding speakers and bookshelf speakers. Exact title 'RECOMMENDED LOUDSPEAKER' in restrained white typography near top. No other text.

Square product photograph of Wharfedale AURA Series, a pair of walnut veneer floorstanding speakers with black round drivers and compact rectangular ribbon tweeters. Exact brand 'WHARFEDALE' small white at top. No other text.
Square product photograph of Mission LX MK II bookshelf speakers in natural walnut and Mission 778X silver integrated amplifier between them. Exact brand 'MISSION' small white at top. No other text.

Square macro product photograph of SINE Banana Gold / Platinum speaker cable banana connectors, pairs of precision polished silver and gold metal banana plugs lying naturally on dark reflective surface, black cable sections. Exact brand 'SINE' small white at top. No other text.

original_reference_highlights.brief: leftmost LEAK tile. Preserve the exact small front-facing walnut LEAK Stereo 230, silver fascia, ALL original controls and black lower fascia. Keep its size and position lower-middle. Preserve large LEAK logo and small NEW ARRIVAL at top.

second audiolab tile. Preserve exact DC Block angled small black cuboid with TWO rectangular AC sockets on facing rear side, white audiolab markings on top and side. Keep angle, two sockets, dimensions and position. Preserve white audiolab logo top and DC BLOCK white bottom.

third WHARFEDALE tile. Preserve EXACT TWO walnut BOOKSHELF speakers, compact boxes with vertical black ribbon tweeter and ONE black woofer each; NOT floorstanding towers. Keep shape, angle, size and position. Preserve WHARFEDALE logo and NEW ARRIVAL top.

rightmost MISSION tile. Preserve EXACT two WHITE bookshelf loudspeakers flanking SMALL SILVER Mission 778X amplifier; inverted woofer top and tweeter bottom on each speaker. Keep all original placement and relative dimensions. Preserve Mission logo and NEW ARRIVAL top.
leftmost WHARFEDALE tile. Preserve EXACT front-facing black square subwoofer with large GRAY SILVER-rimmed cone and FOUR feet, same details and relative size. Preserve WHARFEDALE logo at top.

second MAGNETAR tile. Preserve EXACT front view wide silver-black UDP800 disc player, central rectangular disc tray/display, small controls at right, original relative size and placement. Preserve blue Magnetar emblem and white MAGNETAR logo in top right and NEW ARRIVAL near top left.

third audiolab tile. Preserve EXACT BLACK audiolab 7000A amplifier, front-facing, FOUR knobs and horizontal oval dark central display, ports on far right, relative small size and original placement. DO NOT turn it silver or substitute a single knob amplifier. Preserve large white audiolab logo and NEW ARRIVAL top.

rightmost SINE tile. Preserve EXACT fan arrangement of disconnected banana connector plugs: SILVER plugs cluster LEFT and GOLD plugs cluster RIGHT, NO attached cables, same original orientation and object arrangement. Preserve BLUE SINE logo at top left.

original_reference_promotions.brief: Preserve original home theater and loudspeaker products, composition, HiFi Tower logo, Recommended headline, Shop Now and award badges; replace turquoise details with muted amber and charcoal category lighting.
